title: Med spas and aesthetic cash-pay healthcare
hypothesis: Resolve a public business-contact owner candidate person-first: match an NP, PA, or RN to the exact spa suite, corroborate through a state entity source where available, exclude shared medical directors and corporate brands, then hold until ownership and normal contact gates are measured.
ownerSource: NPPES NPI-1 clinician roster at the exact practice address and suite; state entity officers are corroboration where verified.
phoneSource: Explicitly published business-contact numbers only. NPPES LOCATION or AO fields are candidates; differing MAILING phones are not eligible without independent business-use evidence. No private phone enrichment.

workflow.label: Independent spa input
workflow.detail: Use a lawfully obtained business discovery/register row with name, address, ZIP, and state.

workflow.label: Brand and agent filter
workflow.detail: Reject known franchise, telehealth, corporate-brand, and registered-agent-service candidates before contact work.

workflow.label: Blocked brand or agent
workflow.detail: Do not treat the excluded corporate or registered-agent identity as an owner contact.

workflow.label: NPPES NPI-1 roster
workflow.detail: Query NP, PA, and RN LOCATION records for the five-digit ZIP; API pagination can truncate at its documented ceiling.

workflow.label: Exact-address decision
workflow.detail: Require exact house number, ZIP, high normalized-address score, and no conflicting suite.

workflow.label: No clinician match
workflow.detail: Hold for another lawful identity source; NPPES absence does not mean the cash-pay spa is absent.

workflow.label: Medical-director graph
workflow.detail: Classify a Tennessee director named on three or more registry facilities as director_only.

workflow.label: Director-only candidate
workflow.detail: Never deliver a supervising director as the spa owner without independent owner evidence.

workflow.label: Entity corroboration
workflow.detail: Use a verified state officer/member source when available; Florida two-hop and Texas PIR evidence are not yet implemented as verified production sources.

workflow.label: Owner candidate hold
workflow.detail: Retain role, source, and evidence; a clinician or officer is not owner-confirmed merely from a match.

workflow.label: Contact and compliance gate
workflow.detail: A published business-contact field still needs authorized line-type, reachability, ownership, and DNC evaluation.

workflow.label: Deliver only after gates
workflow.detail: No current measured path qualifies an owner candidate for delivery.

failures.risk: NPPES NPI-2 coverage omits many cash-pay spas and returns adjacent aesthetic practices.
failures.mitigation: Use it as corroborative identity evidence, never as the med-spa universe or a negative screen.

failures.risk: A clinician at the building is an employee or a clinician at another suite.
failures.mitigation: Require exact house number, ZIP, normalized address threshold, and reject conflicting suite values; retain candidate status.

failures.risk: A supervising medical director is mistaken for the owner.
failures.mitigation: Hold names occurring at three or more Tennessee registry facilities as director_only.

failures.risk: Texas officer data is inferred from an unverified HTML layout.
failures.mitigation: Keep the adapter fixture/code-audit only and do not assert live officer coverage.

failures.risk: The resolved candidate never reaches job output.
failures.mitigation: Wire the live resolver into the runner and persist its evidence before considering contact delivery.

sources.label: CMS NPPES Registry API
sources.scope: National NPI-1 roster and NPI-2 organization/AO fields

sources.label: Tennessee Medical Spa Registry director graph

iterations.hypothesis: The narrow NPI-2 aesthetic path exposes titled business-contact candidates.
iterations.test: Free live NPPES Registry API request: Florida NPI-2 organization_name=*aesthetic*, limit=20, on 2026-09-24.
iterations.observed: 20/20 returned records had AO name, AO title, AO telephone, and LOCATION telephone fields; 19/20 titles matched the current owner-title expression and 0/20 matched the staff-title exclusion. This is field coverage only.
iterations.change: Keep NPI-2 as corroboration and retain all candidates behind ownership/contact gates; do not claim owner or handset truth.

iterations.test: Focused synthetic regression checks in tests/lead-engine-industry-corrections.test.ts, lead-engine-reviews.test.ts, lead-engine-gates-jobs.test.ts and lead-engine-jobs.test.ts. No paid provider call.
iterations.observed: NPPES med-spa admissions now require an explicit owner/leadership title. Clinical-only director/doctor/DDS/DMD titles are held. Earlier 19/20 title matches describe the old broad expression, not the corrected filter. The resolver is still not wired; generic phone gates exist but independent owner proof remains unintegrated.
iterations.change: Shared runtime correction integrated. Original source samples are retained with their original denominators; no phone-yield improvement is claimed.

measurement.result: NPPES Florida NPI-2 *aesthetic* sample: 20/20 AO name/title/AO-phone/LOCATION-phone field presence; 19/20 old owner-title matches (before root correction); no owner, mobile, reachable, or DNC outcome measured.

cost.basis: Free public NPPES endpoint sample only; no paid discovery, append, or verification was invoked.
cost.note: A cost per clean owner contact cannot be calculated without measured ownership and contact outcomes.

implementation.summary: NPPES med-spa admissions now require an explicit owner/leadership title. Clinical-only director/doctor/DDS/DMD titles are held. Earlier 19/20 title matches describe the old broad expression, not the corrected filter. The resolver is still not wired; generic phone gates exist but independent owner proof remains unintegrated. Original review: Pure resolution and a free NPPES live resolver exist with tests, but resolveMedSpaOwnerLive has no runtime caller. Florida two-hop corroboration, verified Texas PIR retrieval, NPPES bulk repetition checks, and delivery gates are absent.

nextMeasurement: After the resolver is wired, use a consented 5-20 independent-spa sample to record separate discovered, exact-suite candidate, independently corroborated owner, and authorized line-outcome denominators.
